summary:
RTX Corporation 2026年第二季財報表現強勁，營收與每股盈餘雙雙擊敗市場預期。
• 每股盈餘達 1.89 美元，高於市場預期的 1.66 美元。
• 季度營收達 247.1 億美元，年增率達 14.49%。
• 國防與商用航空業務需求持續穩健擴張。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報展現強勁的營運執行力與國防需求韌性。訊號偏向正面，有助於支撐中短期股價表現。追蹤指標應關注供應鏈交期改善狀況與後續國防訂單能見度。

需留意：全球供應鏈瓶頸與零組件成本上升壓力。；地緣政治與國防預算政策變動的不確定性。

summary_en:
RTX Corporation reported strong Q2 2026 results, beating consensus estimates on both revenue and earnings per share.
• EPS reached $1.89, beating the estimated $1.66.
• Quarterly revenue hit $24.71B, representing a 14.49% year-over-year increase.
• Robust demand continued across both defense and commercial aerospace segments.

View: The earnings report demonstrates strong operational execution and robust defense demand resilience. The signal is positive, supporting near-to-mid-term stock performance. Key tracking metrics include supply chain lead time improvements and future defense order visibility.

Watch：Ongoing global supply chain bottlenecks and rising component cost pressures.; Uncertainties surrounding geopolitical shifts and defense budget policy changes.
